phrases.japanese: 塩辛い しおからい
酸っぱい すっぱい
ありがとうございます
お手数をおかけします
遅れて申し訳ないです

phrases.english: I’m okay, really. Just tired.
phrases.japanese: だいじょうぶ、ほんとに、ちょっと疲れた。
phrases.transliteration: daijoubu, honto ni, chotto tsukareta.

phrases.english: Today feels busy, but I’ll manage.
phrases.japanese: 今日は忙しいけど、なんとかなるよ。
phrases.transliteration: kyou wa isogashii kedo, nantoka naru yo.

phrases.english: Take your time, I’m not rushing.
phrases.japanese: ゆっくりでいいよ、急いでないから。
phrases.transliteration: yukkuri de ii yo, isoide nai kara.

phrases.english: Thanks, that helped a lot.
phrases.japanese: ありがとう、すごく助かったよ。
phrases.transliteration: arigatou, sugoku tasukatta yo.

phrases.english: Sorry, I forgot. My bad.
phrases.japanese: ごめん、忘れてた。ほんとに。
phrases.transliteration: gomen, wasureterta. honto ni.

phrases.english: I like watching baseball games, a lot.
phrases.japanese: 野球の試合を見るのが好きだよ。
phrases.transliteration: yakyuu no shiai o miru no ga suki dayo

phrases.english: Let’s go for a run after work, okay?
phrases.japanese: 仕事のあと走ろう、いい？
phrases.transliteration: shigoto no ato hashirou, ii?

phrases.english: I’m trying to improve my tennis serve.
phrases.japanese: テニスのサーブを上手くなりたい。
phrases.transliteration: tenisu no saabu o umaku naritai

phrases.english: That goal was amazing, honestly!
phrases.japanese: あのゴールはすごかった、まじで！
phrases.transliteration: ano gooru wa sugokatta, maji de!

phrases.english: I hit the ball too hard today.
phrases.japanese: 今日はボールを強く打ちすぎた。
phrases.transliteration: kyou wa booru o tsuyoku uchisugita

phrases.english: It’s sunny today, isn’t it?
phrases.transliteration: Kyou wa hareteru ne.

phrases.english: The sky looks cloudy, though.
phrases.transliteration: Demo sora ga kumoppoi.

phrases.english: It’s raining right now, sorry.
phrases.transliteration: Ima ame ga futteru, ne.

phrases.english: The rain is light, I think.
phrases.transliteration: Ame, kekkou yowai yo.

phrases.english: Stop, it’s going to rain.
phrases.transliteration: Yamete, ame ni narisou.

phrases.english: Take one slow breath, right now.
phrases.japanese: いま、ゆっくり息を一つ。
phrases.transliteration: ima, yukkuri iki o hitotsu.

phrases.english: Let your shoulders soften, gently.
phrases.japanese: 肩の力を、やさしく抜いて。
phrases.transliteration: kata no chikara o, yasashiku nuite.

phrases.english: Feel your feet on the ground.
phrases.japanese: 足の裏を、地面に感じて。
phrases.transliteration: ashi no ura o, jimen ni kanjite.

phrases.english: Notice sounds around you, calmly.
phrases.japanese: 周りの音に、静かに気づいて。
phrases.transliteration: mawari no oto ni, shizuka ni kizuite.

phrases.english: Inhale peace, exhale tension.
phrases.japanese: 深く吸って、緊張を吐いて。
phrases.transliteration: fukaku suwatte, kinchō o haite.

phrases.english: Where is the nearest convenience store?
phrases.japanese: いちばん近いコンビニはどこですか。
phrases.transliteration: ichiban chikai konbini wa doko desu ka

phrases.english: Do you have this in a smaller size?
phrases.japanese: これ、もう少し小さいのありますか。
phrases.transliteration: kore, mou sukoshi chiisai no arimasu ka

phrases.english: Can I try this on, please?
phrases.japanese: これ、試着してもいいですか。
phrases.transliteration: kore, shichaku shite mo ii desu ka

phrases.english: How much is this? Is it on sale?
phrases.japanese: これはいくらですか、セールですか。
phrases.transliteration: kore wa ikura desu ka, se-ru desu ka

phrases.english: I’ll take it, how do I pay?
phrases.japanese: 買います、どうやって支払いますか。
phrases.transliteration: kaimasu, dou yatte shiharai masu ka

phrases.english: I breathe, then I choose better.
phrases.japanese: 深呼吸して、いい選択をする。
phrases.transliteration: shinkokyū shite, ii sentaku o suru

phrases.english: Today, I focus on one small win.
phrases.japanese: 今日は、ひとつの小さな勝利に集中する。
phrases.transliteration: kyō wa, hitotsu no chiisana shōri ni shūchū suru

phrases.english: I forgive myself, and I move on.
phrases.japanese: 自分を許して、前に進む。
phrases.transliteration: jibun o yurusete, mae ni susumu

phrases.english: I drink water, my body feels better.
phrases.japanese: 水を飲んで、体が楽になる。
phrases.transliteration: mizu o nonde, karada ga raku ni naru

phrases.english: I write one page, every day.
phrases.transliteration: mainichi, hito pēji kaku

phrases.english: Don’t quit, just go one step.
phrases.japanese: やめないで、まずは一歩だけ。
phrases.transliteration: Yamenai de, mazu wa ippo dake.

phrases.english: Keep trying, even slowly.
phrases.japanese: ゆっくりでも、続けてみよう。
phrases.transliteration: Yukkuri demo, tsuzukete miyou.

phrases.english: I’ll try again, no matter what.
phrases.japanese: 何があっても、また挑戦する。
phrases.transliteration: Nani ga atte mo, mata chōsen suru.

phrases.english: Small progress is still progress.
phrases.japanese: 小さくても、進んでいるよ。
phrases.transliteration: Chiisakute mo, sunde iru yo.

phrases.english: Breathe, and start again.
phrases.japanese: 深呼吸して、また始めよう。
phrases.transliteration: Shinkokyū shite, mata hajimeyou.

phrases.english: I’ll wait, one moment, okay?
phrases.japanese: 待ってて、ね、ちょっとだけ。
phrases.transliteration: matte te, ne, chotto dake.

phrases.english: Please wait a little, I’m almost ready.
phrases.japanese: もう少し待って、すぐ行くから。
phrases.transliteration: mō sukoshi matte, sugu iku kara.

phrases.english: No rush, take your time.
phrases.japanese: 急がなくていいよ、ゆっくりで。
phrases.transliteration: isoganakute ii yo, yukkuri de.

phrases.english: It’s okay, we’ll try again later.
phrases.japanese: 大丈夫、またあとでやろう。
phrases.transliteration: daijōbu, mata ato de yarō.

phrases.english: Just breathe, everything will work out.
phrases.japanese: 深呼吸して、きっとうまくいくよ。
phrases.transliteration: shinkokyū shite, kitto umaku iku yo.

phrases.english: You’ve got this, just keep going.
phrases.japanese: 大丈夫、ただ進み続けてね。
phrases.transliteration: Daijōbu, tada susumi tsudzukete ne.

phrases.english: Small steps today, big change tomorrow.
phrases.japanese: 今日の小さな一歩が、明日の大きな変化。
phrases.transliteration: Kyō no chiisana ippo ga, ashita no ōkina henka.

phrases.english: Breathe, then try again.
phrases.japanese: 深呼吸して、それからもう一回。
phrases.transliteration: Shin kokyū shite, soredkara mō ikkai.

phrases.english: Even mistakes are part of learning.
phrases.japanese: 失敗も、学びの一部だよ。
phrases.transliteration: Shippai mo, manabi no ichibu da yo.

phrases.english: Show up, even if you’re tired.
phrases.japanese: 疲れてても、行ってみよう。
phrases.transliteration: Tsukarete temo, itte miyō.

phrases.english: I checked my bank balance today, just now.
phrases.japanese: さっき口座残高を確認したよ。
phrases.transliteration: sakki kōza zandaka o kakunin shita yo.

phrases.english: How much is the monthly fee, exactly?
phrases.japanese: 月額料金はいくらですか、正確に。
phrases.transliteration: getsugaku ryōkin wa ikura desu ka, seikaku ni.

phrases.english: I transferred money to my savings.
phrases.japanese: 貯金にお金を振り込んだよ。
phrases.transliteration: chokin ni okane o furikonde ita yo.

phrases.english: Please cancel my subscription, I beg you.
phrases.japanese: サブスクを解約して,お願いします。
phrases.transliteration: sabusuku o kaik yaku shite, onega i shimasu.

phrases.english: My card payment went through smoothly.
phrases.japanese: カード決済、すんなり通ったよ。
phrases.transliteration: kādo kessai, sun'nari totta yo.

phrases.english: You’ve got this, keep going.
phrases.transliteration: daijōbu, tsuzukete ne

phrases.english: Nice work, that’s a win.
phrases.transliteration: ii ne, katta yo

phrases.english: Great job, you nailed it!
phrases.japanese: すごい、うまくできたね。
phrases.transliteration: sugoi, umaku dekita ne

phrases.english: I’m proud of you, seriously.
phrases.japanese: 本当にすごいね、誇りだよ。
phrases.transliteration: hontō ni sugoi ne, hokori da yo

phrases.english: Take a breath, you can do it.
phrases.transliteration: shinkokyū shite, dekiru yo

phrases.english: I’m counting to ten, now.
phrases.japanese: いま十まで数えてるよ。
phrases.transliteration: ima juu made kazoeteru yo

phrases.english: Give me three, please.
phrases.transliteration: mittsu kudasai

phrases.english: We need five more minutes.
phrases.transliteration: ato go-fun hitsuyou da yo

phrases.english: My phone is number seven.
phrases.transliteration: watashi no denwa wa nana-ban da yo

phrases.english: Wait, it’s 12 o’clock.
phrases.transliteration: matte, juu-ni-ji da yo

phrases.english: Happy holidays, have a great break.
phrases.japanese: 楽しいホリデーを、いい休暇を。
phrases.transliteration: Tanoshii horidē o, ii kyūka o.

phrases.english: Merry Christmas, I hope you’re warm.
phrases.japanese: メリークリスマス、あったかく過ごしてね。
phrases.transliteration: Merii kurisumasu, attakaku sugoshite ne.

phrases.english: Season’s greetings, let’s meet soon.
phrases.japanese: ごきげんよう、また近いうちにね。
phrases.transliteration: Gokigenyō, mata chikai uchi ni ne.

phrases.english: Happy New Year, wishing you health.
phrases.japanese: 新年おめでとう、健康でいてね。
phrases.transliteration: Shinnen omedetō, kenkō de ite ne.

phrases.english: Enjoy the holidays, take care.
phrases.japanese: ホリデーを楽しんでね、気をつけて。
phrases.transliteration: Horidē o tanoshinde ne, ki o tsukete.

phrases.english: Help me, please. I need assistance.
phrases.japanese: 助けてください、助けが必要です。
phrases.transliteration: tasukete kudasai, tasuke ga hitsuyō desu.

phrases.english: Stop! Somebody call an ambulance now!
phrases.japanese: 止まって！誰か、今すぐ救急車を呼んで！
phrases.transliteration: tomatte! dareka, ima sugu kyūkyūsha o yonde!

phrases.english: I’m lost. Please help me find home.
phrases.japanese: 迷子です、家まで案内してください。
phrases.transliteration: maigo desu, ie made annai shite kudasai.

phrases.english: Is everyone okay? Any injuries?
phrases.japanese: みんな大丈夫？けがはありますか。
phrases.transliteration: min’na daijōbu? kega wa arimasu ka.

phrases.english: My chest hurts. Please call a doctor.
phrases.japanese: 胸が痛いです、医者を呼んでください。
phrases.transliteration: mune ga itai desu, iasha o yonde kudasai.

phrases.english: I feel happy today, so easy.
phrases.japanese: 今日はすごく幸せ、気持ちが軽い。
phrases.transliteration: Kyou wa sugoku shiawase, kimochi ga karui.

phrases.english: Smile, things will work out.
phrases.japanese: にこっとして、きっとうまくいくよ。
phrases.transliteration: Niko tto shite, kitto umaku iku yo.

phrases.english: Grateful for this peaceful moment, really.
phrases.japanese: この穏やかな時間に感謝してる。
phrases.transliteration: Kono odayakana jikan ni kansha shiteru.

phrases.english: My heart is warm right now.
phrases.transliteration: Ima, kokoro ga attakai.

phrases.english: I’m lucky to have you, truly.
phrases.japanese: あなたがいてくれて、ほんとに幸せ。
phrases.transliteration: Anata ga ite kurete, honto ni shiawase.

phrases.english: Thanks for being my friend, always.
phrases.japanese: いつも友だちでいてくれてありがとう。
phrases.transliteration: Itsumo tomodachi de ite kurete arigatou.

phrases.english: I’m lucky to have you.
phrases.japanese: あなたに出会えてよかった。
phrases.transliteration: Anata ni deaete yokatta.

phrases.english: Let’s hang out this weekend.
phrases.transliteration: Kongeshumatsu, aou ne.

phrases.english: You can always count on me.
phrases.japanese: いつでも私を頼ってね。
phrases.transliteration: Itsudemo watashi o tayotte ne.

phrases.english: Your smile makes me happy.
phrases.japanese: あなたの笑顔に元気もらうよ。
phrases.transliteration: Anata no egao ni genki mora u yo.
